name: Paani Tank Alarm
tagline: Beeps once and shows Refill the tank when the water runs low, and keeps an eye on the plant's soil too

behaviour.summary: Shows the soil moisture and whether the tank float is up. When the float drops it beeps once and the screen says Refill the tank; when the soil reads below 30 % it says Water me. Readings are also on its own page on the home Wi-Fi. It does not pump water.

safety.notes: The float and the probe stay in the tank and the pot; the gadget stays dry beside them and only their leads pass the strain-relieved cable exits. No pump, no mains. External certified USB-C 5 V supply.
